annotations.title: IP intelligence: owner, network, reverse DNS and type

description: One call for everything about an IP address: its type (public, private, loopback, carrier-grade NAT), the registry record (holding organisation, network name and range, registration country, abuse contact) and the reverse DNS name. IPv4 and IPv6. Registration country, not city geolocation. Cheaper than the tools bought one by one. Use to investigate an address in logs, a login or an abuse report. Example: ip=8.8.8.8. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
